requiredBehaviors.behavior: bind review approval and required checks to the exact reviewed head before declaring merge readiness

requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep merge, deployment and issue or requirement closure as separate evidence states

requiredBehaviors.behavior: produce a return input that prevents completed work from being repeated in the next iteration
